classification.difficultyReason: Identify both curved surfaces and the exposed annular rim of a hollow hemisphere, deriving the inner radius from the wall thickness.

content.prompt: Find the surface area of this hemispherical bird bath with outer radius $40\text{ cm}$ and $1\text{ cm}$ thick walls. Round your answer to 1 decimal place.

spec.description: Open hollow hemisphere with concentric outer and inner elliptical rim boundaries, an unobstructed cavity, a lower hemispherical silhouette and a centre-to-outer-rim radius arrow. Unsupported hollow-solid composite reconstructed with native free-form TikZ; independent geometry review is required.
spec.mathematics: Outer radius 40 cm and uniform wall thickness 1 cm. The inner rim radius is proportional to 39/40 of the outer radius. Only the source-supplied outer radius is labelled.
spec.answerVisibility: The 40 cm radius is a permanent given. The derived inner radius and all surface-area calculations appear only in answers.

answer.worked:
The inner radius is $40-1=39\text{ cm}$. Include the outer curved surface, inner curved surface and annular rim.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{outer}}&=2\pi(40)^2\\
A_{\text{outer}}&=3200\pi\text{ cm}^2\\
A_{\text{inner}}&=2\pi(39)^2\\
A_{\text{inner}}&=3042\pi\text{ cm}^2\\
A_{\text{rim}}&=\pi(40)^2-\pi(39)^2\\
A_{\text{rim}}&=79\pi\text{ cm}^2\\
A_{\text{total}}&=3200\pi+3042\pi+79\pi\\
A_{\text{total}}&=6321\pi\text{ cm}^2\\
A_{\text{total}}&\approx19\,858.0\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
